rows.text: Recognised by the 2021 Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index for the third consecutive year. Included in the Refinitiv Global Diversity & Inclusion Index 2020 for the second time

rows.text: Launched the Optus Accessibility and Inclusion Action Plan 2020–2023 to support persons with disabilities
rows.source_sentence: We launched the Optus Accessibility and Inclusion Action Plan 2020–2023, which will guide us as we build long term opportunities, remove barriers to access and ‘Power Optimism with Options’ for persons with disabilities in our workforce, marketplace and community.

rows.text: Launched the Singtel Digital Silvers programme to empower seniors with digital skills
rows.source_sentence: Under Singtel’s digital enablement strategy, we launched the Singtel Digital Silvers programme in Singapore to help bridge those gaps, empowering seniors with digital skills so they feel less displaced by technology.

rows.text: 88% of seniors expressed more confidence in using mobile phones after attending digital skills sessions
rows.source_sentence: 88% of them have expressed more confidence in using their mobile phones after attending our sessions.

rows.text: Endorsed TCFD framework in 2017 and GSMA’s global ambition of achieving net zero emissions by 2050
rows.source_sentence: We endorsed the TCFD framework in 2017 and GSMA’s global ambition of achieving net zero emissions by 2050 for the telecommunications sector last year.

rows.text: Singtel approves ESG-linked LTI Performance Share Award, where 20% of LTI is weighted to ESG KPIs, including people sustainability KPIs e.g. diversity and inclusion – women in leadership.
rows.source_sentence: • Approves ESG-linked LTI Performance Share Award, where 20% of LTI is weighted to ESG KPIs, including people sustainability KPIs e.g. diversity and inclusion – women in leadership

rows.text: Singtel aims to reduce absolute carbon emissions by 25% for Scope 1 and 2 by 2025, using 2015 as baseline.
rows.source_sentence: Climate Change and Carbon Reduce absolute carbon emissions by 25% for Scope 1 and 2 by 2025, using 2015 as baseline, in line with our 2030 SBTi targets and 2050 net zero ambitions

rows.text: Singtel upholds the highest standards of customer data privacy protection and cyber security measures in adherence to data protection laws.
rows.source_sentence: Data Privacy and Cyber Security Uphold the highest standards of customer data privacy protection and cyber security measures in adherence to data protection laws – Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) in Singapore and the Privacy Act and Telecommunications Act in Australia – with zero major incident

rows.text: The company likely prioritizes energy efficiency and renewable energy adoption, particularly in its data centers and network operations, as part of its broader climate action strategy.
